candidates.title: Retained protocol stay test versus SAP/report stay method
candidates.statement: The final protocol retains survival-stratified Wilcoxon comparisons of ICU and acute-hospital stay, while both SAP versions and the report specify Fine–Gray competing-risk regression, without explicitly reconciling replacement versus addition.

candidates.statement: Final SAP §7 specifies MICE models using all outcome variables, while the results supplement lists selected auxiliary outcomes or None and early censoring for unavailable stay times. candidates.title: Pilot adherence numerator and progression direction
candidates.statement: Both SAP pilot tables apply high-is-Green treatment-adherence thresholds to a footnoted fraction with at least one adjudicated protocol deviation, while the supplied adherence definition uses no deviation; these complementary event definitions imply different progression classifications.
